title: Dancing Through Ruins
description: Kukeri are part of Bulgaria’s winter traditions, which take many different forms across the country. Elaborately costumed in masks, animal skins, and bells, the dancers move through villages and enter households, performing rituals associated with driving away evil spirits and welcoming health, fertility, and prosperity.
translated_description: 库克里是保加利亚冬季传统的一部分，在全国各地有着多种不同的形式。舞者们身着精心制作的面具、兽皮和铃铛，穿行于村庄之间，进入各家各户，表演与驱赶邪灵、迎接健康、生育和繁荣相关的仪式。
